newsitem.title: ITALY: Banco Napoli merger to proceed quickly-BNL.
newsitem.headline: Banco Napoli merger to proceed quickly-BNL.

text.p: Italian state-controlled bank Banca Nazionale del Lavoro said it aimed to merge its operations with Banco di Napoli in a short time.
BNL made the announcement after the stock market authority Consob asked it to confirm it was intending a rapid integration of its operations with the Naples-based bank.
Last month, the Italian Treasury confirmed that it had completed the sale of a 60 percent stake in Banco di Napoli to BNL and its partner, insurance group INA INA.MI.
On Monday, BNL chairman Mario Sarcinelli said that BNL had not yet started the process of due diligence on the merger, but that it was in BNL's interest to merge the two banks as quickly as possible.
